findings.description: [BLOCKER | Band 1 Dark+Light | Bottom-right IN PROGRESS, y~240-300] Missing 4th focus project ('After Effects') and severe bottom viewport clipping: the 800x300 viewBox cuts off the bottom ~15-20% of my-web-2026's blue circle, clips the bottom of Tastile's green circle and 'scheduling product' subtitle, and completely clips/omits the 4th declared project (After Effects), violating the no-deletion requirement (M2, M4, M5). Increase Band 1 height (e.g. 800x360-380) and arrange all 4 projects horizontally/spatially with guaranteed bottom padding.

[BLOCKER | Band 1 Dark+Light | Bottom-right IN PROGRESS, x~60-72%] Text-over-glyph collisions and project ring overlap: 'AI coding agent / agent workflows' and 'Tastile / scheduling product' are rendered directly on top of their purple/green circle glyphs, destroying both icon and text legibility, while the two concentric rings overlap vertically (creating an accidental false link). Also 'IN PROGRESS' touches my-web-2026's top ring and the leftmost blue dash overlaps my-web-2026's outer ring (M2, M3, M5). Place all labels outside icons and enforce non-overlapping node spacing.

[BLOCKER | Band 2 Dark+Light | Left REPO OUTPUT 30D, x~20-62%] Severe isotype overflow and collisions across all 10 rows: with dot=50 commits, FlashBeat (2.1kc, ~42 dots), private repos (1.9kc, ~38 dots), and my-web-2026 (1.8kc, ~36 dots) run directly through their right-aligned commit counts. Worse, purple PR squares (square=25 PRs) overlap the '...p' text on EVERY single row (572p, 352p, 51p, 90p, 40p, 60p, 74p, 30p, 101p, 548p), and on FlashBeat, my-web-2026, and private repos they wrap and bleed across into the LAST 72 HOURS bordered box and below the event feed (M3, M4, M5). Allocate dedicated non-overlapping columns and replace 42-dot horizontal runs with a bounded visual encoding (e.g. proportional commit+PR bars with scale ticks, or grouped/larger unit blocks) that cannot overflow into text or adjacent panels.

[BLOCKER | Band 1 Dark+Light | Middle vitals row, Cards 1, 3, 4] Multiple text-on-graphic collisions inside vitals cards: (1) Card 3 'CONTRIBUTED TO · 1Y' draws '27 repos' directly on top of rows 3-4 of the blue dot matrix; (2) Card 4 'GITHUB RANK' draws 'C / A+ tier' directly over the bottom stroke of the thick blue B+ arc, rendering it illegible in both dark and light; (3) Card 1 flame icon overlaps/clips the left edge of '2' in '204' (M5). Separate label baselines from graphic bounding boxes in all three tiles.

[BLOCKER | Band 2 Dark+Light | Left REPO OUTPUT 30D row 10, bottom-left] Truncated private-repo label and bottom-rule crowding: row 10 cuts off mid-word as 'private repos (aggrega', hiding the repo count and closing parenthesis, while its counts ('1.9kc · 548p') and overflowing purple PR squares collide with the bottom horizontal divider rule (M5). Widen the label column or use a concise complete label (e.g. '8 private repos') and add bottom padding.

[BLOCKER | Band 2 Dark+Light | Header top-right vs bottom-right event feed] Timezone mismatch between JST and UTC: both Band 1 and Band 2 headers read 'observed Nov 24 · 23:00 JST', while the 3 recent event rows under LAST 72 HOURS read '17:46 UTC', '17:22 UTC', '16:59 UTC' without dates (M5). Readers cannot reconcile '17:46 UTC' with the '-24h..now' gap without manual UTC+9 conversion. Unify on one timezone (prefer JST to match header, or show relative offsets like '20h ago' alongside consistent JST/UTC timestamps).

[BLOCKER | Band 2 Mobile 01-v2-mob.png | ~350px width] Mobile survival failure for 42-dot isotype and micro-typography: scaling 800px SVGs to ~350px shrinks body/axis/legend labels to ~4-5px (illegible in both bands). Even with dedicated stacked mobile SVG variants planned, a 42-dot-wide fixed-unit commit row (FlashBeat 2.1k @ 50/dot) cannot remain countable at ~350px width without wrapping into dense dot blocks; switch to proportional bars or larger/grouped unit encoding so the visual language survives mobile stacking (M5, Mobile survival).

[BLOCKER | Band 2 Dark+Light | Left REPO OUTPUT 30D rows 5-6] Unexplained hollow circles in isotype: atcoder-kit (149c) and herdr-t3 (129c) display 2 filled dots + 1 hollow dot, while pc-setup (121c) and dotfiles (269c) show only filled dots. Hollow dots are absent from the '● = 50 commits · ■ = 25 PRs' legend, making the rounding/partial-unit rule opaque (M2, M5). Either add the half-unit symbol to the legend or use a continuous proportional bar.

[POLISH | Band 1 Dark+Light | Middle vitals row & IN PROGRESS] Residual card-boxing and unexplained focus weight grammar: Band 1's 4 vitals are still enclosed in 4 rounded-rect cards that visually outweigh the bottom IN PROGRESS focus map (M1, M4). In IN PROGRESS, the concentric rings and the 3 blue horizontal dashes under my-web-2026 lack a clear visual grammar/legend distinguishing primary vs active vs side tiers, and online presence ('online on Discord') relies on small text instead of a glanceable green status badge on the avatar (M1, M2, M3). Unbox/lighten vitals separators, elevate IN PROGRESS hierarchy, and attach presence visually to the identity mark.

[POLISH | Band 1 & Band 2 Dark vs Light | Secondary text & color-only cues] Dark-mode low contrast and color-only encodings: in Dark variants, secondary metadata ('observed Nov 24 · 23:00 JST', 'day streak', 'C# 40.9 · C++ 7.9 · +3 more', 'agent workflows', 'scheduling product', '-72h..-24h/now', '+22 more public', '29 public events in window', and muted rows 9-10 dots) are overly dim compared to Light variants (M5). Also TOP LANGUAGE secondary labels lack color dots matching the stacked bar segments, and LAST 72 HOURS uses the same diamond shape for all 4 event types (push/PR/new/del), relying solely on color (M1, M2). Boost dark-mode muted text contrast, add language color swatches, and consider shape or distinct hue separation for push vs PR.

[INFO | Scope verification | Root requirement completeness] Work showcase preservation check: Bands 1 and 2 represent 7 of the 8 required features (repo activity, 72h feed, 204d streak, stats/rank/contributed-to, top langs, Discord presence, and focus map once After Effects is restored). Work showcase is not inside Bands 1-2; ensure it remains represented in the README outside these two bands so no existing feature is deleted. Positive verified wins: exact 27-dot contributed matrix, truthful ~68% B+ rank arc, proportional language bar, consistent -72h-to-now axis, 29 diamonds matching 29 public events, and clear visual reduction in text dominance vs old text-panel cards once layout bugs are fixed.

verdict.summary:
FINAL VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES — Does NOT yet satisfy the owner's root requirement cleanly enough to implement. The two-band architectural direction, visual idioms, and truthful data foundations are strong and genuinely less text-dominant than the old text-panel cards, but both bands suffer critical SVG layout/clipping/collision defects (including a missing 4th focus project) that break legibility and honesty in dark, light, and mobile views.

PREVIOUS ROUND MANDATED FIXES VERIFICATION:
1. Two unboxed modular bands: PARTIAL — outer bands are split and unboxed, but Band 1's 4 vitals remain boxed cards and both 800x300 / 800x340 canvases are severely crammed.
2. Focus rebuilt with domain-semantic glyphs + honest weight, no fake links: PARTIAL — domain glyphs (browser, agent nodes, calendar) replaced monograms and fake links are gone, but 'After Effects' (4th project) is missing/clipped, text sits directly on top of glyphs, AI coding agent & Tastile rings overlap vertically, and my-web-2026 & Tastile are clipped at y=300.
3. Truthful encodings (legend, exact counts, consistent time axis, event legend, private-repo row): PARTIAL — 27 exact dots, ~68% B+ arc, proportional language bar, -72h..now axis, 29-diamond pulse, and private row exist, but commit dots crash through commit counts, PR squares collide with PR counts on every row and bleed into the 72h panel, 'private repos (aggrega' is truncated, hollow dots lack a legend entry, and header JST mismatches feed UTC.
4. Light & dark variants rendered and checked: MET (process) — both themes exhibit identical structural collisions; Dark has low contrast on muted captions/axis ticks/rows 9-10 while Light is crisper but makes overlaps more jarring.
5. Mobile survival: MISSING — at ~350px width text drops to ~4-5px (illegible), and even with stacked mobile SVGs a 42-dot-wide fixed-unit commit row will not survive narrow viewports without switching to proportional bars or larger/grouped units.

PER-BAND EVALUATION (M1-M7):
- Band 1 (800x300, Identity + Vitals + Focus Map):
  - M1 Text-dependence: PARTIAL (dark & light) — metrics/focus use visual idioms, but presence is still tiny text, language legend lacks color swatches, and vitals remain 4 boxed cards.
  - M2 Visual semantics: PARTIAL (dark & light) — 27 dots, ~68% arc, proportional lang bar, and domain glyphs encode real data, but concentric rings/3 dashes lack clear weight grammar, ring overlap implies a false link, and After Effects is missing/clipped.
  - M3 Glance test (2s): PARTIAL (dark & light) — handle, 204 streak, lang split, B+, and large primary project read fast; presence is subtle and bottom-right focus reads as a broken overlapping cluster with 4th project invisible.
  - M4 Hierarchy: PARTIAL (dark & light) — middle boxed vitals visually overpower the clipped IN PROGRESS focus map at the bottom edge.
  - M5 Honesty/legibility: MISSING (dark & light; dark additionally dim on muted labels) — truthful 27 dots & ~68% arc, but broken by bottom clipping (my-web-2026, Tastile, missing After Effects), text-over-glyphs (AI coding agent, Tastile), '27 repos' over dots, 'C / A+ tier' over B+ arc, flame touching '2' in 204, and illegible mobile text.
  - M6 GitHub fitness: PARTIAL (dark & light) — strong Camo-ready SVG palette/typography undermined by visible template collisions/clipping.
  - M7 Improvement vs text-panel cards: PARTIAL (conceptual MET, execution PARTIAL) — meaningfully more visual once collisions/clipping are resolved.

- Band 2 (800x340, 30d Repo Activity + 72h Event Pulse):
  - M1 Text-dependence: MET conceptually / PARTIAL in render (dark & light) — bimodal repo output and 3 recent activity bursts read without sequential text, though collisions muddy the seam.
  - M2 Visual semantics: PARTIAL (dark & light) — fixed-unit dots/squares and 29 color-coded diamonds encode real data, but hollow dots (atcoder-kit, herdr-t3) are absent from legend and 4 event types use color-only identical diamonds.
  - M3 Glance test (2s): PARTIAL (dark & light) — FlashBeat/my-web-2026/private dominance and 72h pulse bursts pop immediately, but the center seam looks like a collision crash.
  - M4 Hierarchy: PARTIAL (dark & light) — good 30d vs 72h split degraded by FlashBeat/my-web-2026 purple squares invading the LAST 72 HOURS card border.
  - M5 Honesty/legibility: MISSING (dark & light; dark dimmer on muted text/rows 9-10) — honest -72h..now axis and 29-event count, but commit dots run over 2.1kc/1.8kc/1.9kc, PR squares overlap '...p' on all 10 rows and bleed into the 72h panel, 'private repos (aggrega' truncates mid-word, JST header conflicts with UTC event times, hollow dots are unexplained, and 42-dot rows fail at ~350px mobile.
  - M6 GitHub fitness: PARTIAL (dark & light) — editorial Camo-ready data-viz style currently broken by overflows and truncation.
  - M7 Improvement vs text-panel cards: MET conceptually / PARTIAL in render (dark & light) — clearly superior to text-panel tables/feeds once column layout and encoding scale are fixed.

RANKED REMAINING ITEMS:
1. [BLOCKER] Band 1: Restore missing 4th project ('After Effects'), increase SVG height, eliminate bottom clipping of my-web-2026 and Tastile, place labels outside glyphs, and separate AI coding agent & Tastile rings.
2. [BLOCKER] Band 2: Fix repo output column geometry and encoding so commit marks and PR marks NEVER overlap counts or bleed into LAST 72 HOURS (replace 42-dot horizontal runs with proportional bars or bounded grouped units that also survive ~350px mobile).
3. [BLOCKER] Band 1: Fix all 3 vitals collisions ('27 repos' over dots, 'C / A+ tier' over B+ arc, flame touching '2' in 204).
4. [BLOCKER] Band 2: Fix truncated 'private repos (aggrega' label and bottom-rule crowding.
5. [BLOCKER] Band 2: Unify JST/UTC timestamps between header ('23:00 JST') and 72h event rows ('17:46 UTC', add date or relative age).
6. [BLOCKER] Mobile: Design dedicated stacked mobile layouts with legible font scale (>=11-12px effective) and mobile-safe repo activity bars.
7. [BLOCKER] Band 2: Document hollow-dot half-unit in legend or switch to proportional bars.
8. [POLISH] Band 1: Lighten/unbox vitals framing so IN PROGRESS leads hierarchy; attach Discord online dot to avatar; clarify primary/active/side visual weight grammar; add color swatches to TOP LANGUAGE secondary list.
9. [POLISH] Dark theme & accessibility: Raise dark-mode contrast on muted captions/axis ticks/aggregated rows; consider distinct shapes or higher hue separation for push vs PR in 72h pulse.
10. [INFO] Confirm work showcase remains represented in the README outside Bands 1-2.
